description: Uffelmann et al. Alzheimer's disease genetics converges on microglial and neuronal dysregulation. Nature, published 28 October 2026. doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11206-y. Licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. A genome-wide association study of Alzheimer's disease. Add the genes the study names at each associated locus.

proposal.notes: SD2 lists the 127 loci from the multi-ancestry meta-analysis, with predicted effector gene(s) per locus in column 'Predicted effector gene(s)'. Header is on row 2. Rows 3-129 are data.

Each slash-separated gene in 'Predicted effector gene(s)' becomes its own edge to Alzheimer disease. These are the effector genes the paper predicts for each GWAS locus (via FLAMES and related methods), so the agent is a computational pipeline. Non-gene entries such as 'IGH gene cluster' and lncRNA-style names (e.g. AC008394.1) will not resolve to a graph protein and are left unmatched. Literature and Coloc_MR columns are not used, since they are literature or colocalisation candidates rather than the study's named effector genes. Direction of effect is not mapped as a qualifier.
